browser.evidence: actual isolated Chromium execution with synthetic records and injected models; not native QQ
browser.latestChangeBoundary: The final experience suite verifies the legacy UI/helper branch; assistant and history suites precede that bounded compatibility edit.

live.initialRuntimeBoundary: Initial report hashes covered owned runtime files; later reports record all loaded runtime files. Do not attribute later fixes to earlier runs.

productFailure.failure: Stale run revision after a valid feedback review with stateReview=no_change
productFailure.cause: Direct state CAS serialized hydrated display-only feedback; subsequent normalization changed the companion revision.
productFailure.fix: Canonical companion serialization shared by every persistent write

partialCases.verified: Two successful live memory passes preserve cancellation after older invitation and acceptance arrive
partialCases.notVerified: Foreground review failed because the upstream provider was unavailable

semanticReview.result: Eight completed scenarios were semantically acceptable for the specific synthetic inputs; no relationship-effectiveness inference.
semanticReview.relativeDateFix: The unchanged cross-week fixture initially produced an ambiguous upcoming-Friday suggestion. Protocol .6 retest explicitly preserves the old date and asks to confirm current timing.

contextRotPair.observed: Both responses use the stated cooperative-game preference, condition the invitation on availability, and separate activity willingness from romantic intent.
contextRotPair.scope: One controlled pair, not a context-rot robustness benchmark.

semanticReview.remainingUsability: Some review outputs are verbose and contain process caveats.

live.versionBoundary: Runs use their recorded load-time hashes. Prompt/memory .6 includes later date and user-reported activity fixes. Source files changed between/during some runs; final structural/UI/native checks are separate from these live semantic results.

limits: Structural tests and simulated journeys do not establish relationship effectiveness.
Live conversations are synthetic; output verbosity remains a usability observation, not a success score.
Missing end times remain unspecified; relative-date interpretation still depends on model judgment.
Old historical sources rebuild incrementally while raw source retrieval remains usable.
Historical binaries cannot safely write the new database; service refresh stops the old writer and downgrade requires a private pre-upgrade backup.

nativeRegression.failure: Complete serialized text request exceeded 64000 bytes (65281), despite meeting the 48000-byte payload budget.
nativeRegression.cause: Selection did not reserve actual system and nested JSON envelope overhead.
nativeRegression.repair: Use one actual serialized-envelope measurement during selection, drafting and repair; rebind smaller memory batches to their complete request budget. Do not raise the configured cap.
